claims.text: The deviation is established on the trace, not on the rounded trip record. POL-RD-01 makes gps_trace.trace_distance_km the governing measure and expressly forbids citing trip_record.actual_distance_km for the threshold test: the trace records 23.86 km against a booked optimal of 9.4 km, an excess of 14.46 km, or 153.8% of optimal. Both limbs of the establishment test are cleared many times over — the excess is greater than 20% of optimal and greater than 0.8 km in absolute terms.

The excess of 14.46 km is also greater than 8.0 km and greater than 50% of optimal, so this is a MATERIAL deviation under POL-RD-01 and the driver-profile check in POL-RD-06 is mandatory. I run that check and concede its result: the driver has 0 deviation flags in the trailing 90 days across 250 completed trips, so no pattern is established, and neither the FULL_REFUND uplift in POL-RD-06(b) nor the conduct referral in POL-RD-06(c) is available. The material finding stands; the remedy is the POL-RD-02 arithmetic figure.

POL-RD-02 fixes the money, and the fare model is METERED, so the clause runs: recomputed_fare = ((3.80 base fare + 0.75 x 9.4 km optimal + 0.28 x 14.0 min optimal) x 1.0 surge multiplier read from the fare_breakdown) + 0.80 platform fee + 0 ERP + 0 fixed surcharge + 0 waiting fee - 0 promo = 15.57. Charged_total is 33.17. Refund = 33.17 - 15.57 = 17.60, which is above the SGD 0.50 de minimis floor, and at 53.06% of charged_total it falls short of the 90% share that would make it a full refund. The rider is entitled to a PARTIAL_REFUND of SGD 17.60, rounded up to the nearest SGD 0.05.

The driver's explanation — that a car behind flashed its high beams so he assumed an accident ahead and stayed on the expressway — is an asserted external traffic cause, and POL-RD-13 requires that assertion to be tested against the traffic_advisory for this trip and nothing else. There is no such advisory on file: EV-ADVIS-00504-01 is MISSING, carries issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, weight_multiplier 0.0, and I disclose that impairment expressly. The POL-RD-03 comparison therefore cannot be run at all, POL-RD-03 is unavailable, and the assertion carries no weight under POL-RD-08. Because the driver names no advisory evidence ID, the absent artifact is not an exculpatory clause invoked against a cited artifact, so POL-RD-13(1) keeps this outside POL-RD-10(5): the deviation stands at the measured figure and POL-RD-02 runs against the booked optimal route.

The rider has discharged the initial burden under POL-RD-08. Limb (a): trip_record, gps_trace and fare_breakdown all carry trip ID TRP-00504 and the trace and trip record agree on the 18:16:40 start. Limb (b): the excess of 14.46 km meets the POL-RD-01 threshold and is measured from an unimpaired trace, so no independent corroboration is required. The burden has shifted to the driver to point to a specific artifact and a specific clause for POL-RD-03, POL-RD-04, POL-RD-05, POL-RD-11 or POL-RD-12, and he points to none: no advisory, no chat message, no amended endpoint. His general assertion that he thought the road was closed does not discharge the burden and is discarded. The rider's own profile raises no extra hurdle — 0 deviation claims in the last 60 days — so nothing further is required of her.

The trace is clean for policy purposes as well as schema purposes. EV-GPS-00504 has 100% coverage, 229 fixes at a 10-second cadence, an empty gaps array and max_gap_sec of 0.0 — no gap over 90 seconds, no jump over 500 m, no sustained interval above 30 seconds. POL-RD-07 therefore imposes no independent-corroboration requirement on this claim and POL-RD-10(3) is not engaged, so the deviation may be established on the trace alone and no corroborating artifact need carry it.

No other exculpatory route is open to the driver on this record. EV-CHAT-00504 is an empty export — message_count 0, no messages, no waypoint_hint — so there is no rider instruction of the kind POL-RD-04 requires and its corroboration test cannot even be run. The trip record shows pickup_amended_at and dropoff_amended_at both null, so POL-RD-05's amended-endpoint recomputation has no stored amended optimal to work from and does not apply. The vehicle_type is RYDE_X, not RYDE_POOL, so POL-RD-12's matched-itinerary baseline is irrelevant and the solo optimal of 9.4 km is the correct comparator.

There is no pass-through line to add on top of the POL-RD-02 refund and no billing-integrity correction to make. The fare breakdown charges no ERP (erp_gantries empty, off-route and on-route totals both 0.00), no tolls and no airport surcharge, and the trip does not originate at an airport in any event. Nothing under POL-RD-09 is separately refundable, and equally nothing is double-counted: the SGD 17.60 computed under POL-RD-02 is the whole of the money the rider recovers.

The driver keeps the SGD 15.57 the trip was worth on the optimal route; no more than SGD 17.60 moves, and the 'nearly three times the normal price' in the claim is not a measure of anything the policy refunds.

POL-RD-06's driver_profile check is properly triggered by the material deviation, but it produces nothing against this driver. The excess is 14.46 km and 153.83% of the 9.4 km optimal route, against POL-RD-01's material figures of 8.0 km and 50%, so the check must be run; on the only two fields POL-RD-06 permits, driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 0 and driver_profile.completed_trips_90d is 250, and neither limb of the pattern test is met (0 is below 3, and 0/250 is 0.00 against the 0.05 ratio with the 40-trip minimum satisfied). There is therefore no FULL_REFUND uplift of charged_total under POL-RD-06(b) and no driver-conduct referral under POL-RD-06(c): the remedy stays at the ordinary POL-RD-02 partial figure. The lifetime prior_deviation_flags counter, and every other field on the profile, may not be substituted for the trailing-90-day figure under POL-GEN-01.

Nothing is added on top of the distance-and-time refund. The fare ledger carries no ERP or toll lines at all — off-optimal-route total SGD 0.00 and on-optimal-route total SGD 0.00 — and its airport_surcharge line is SGD 0.00, so the standalone pass-through correction POL-RD-09 provides for off-route gantries and wrongly applied surcharges is nil on this trip. Under POL-RD-09(1) any off-route ERP would in any event already be comprehended in the POL-RD-02 refund and must never be added to it a second time. The rider's recovery is the distance-and-time differential and nothing else.

The driver's account — a car behind him flashing high beams near the exit, an expected accident ahead, staying on the expressway and turning back at the next exit — is on the file, but this brief does not claim it exonerates him, because on this record it cannot. The only traffic advisory for the trip, EV-ADVIS-00504-01, is MISSING, carrying admissibility weight 0.0 and the issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT: no advisory covers the PIE eastbound between Paya Lebar and Tampines in this window. ruling.explanation:
Rider and driver both: this case is decided on the platform's own measurements, and it comes to a partial refund of SGD 17.60.

THE ROUTE. The GPS trace (EV-GPS-00504) records 23.86 km driven between the recorded pickup and dropoff against a booked optimal route of 9.4 km (EV-TRIP-00504, the governing optimal estimate). The excess is 14.46 km, or 153.8% of optimal. That clears both POL-RD-01 establishment tests (more than 20% of optimal and more than 0.8 km absolute) and is additionally a MATERIAL deviation (over 50% and over 8.0 km), so the driver-profile check in POL-RD-06 had to be run: the driver has 0 deviation flags in the trailing 90 days across 250 completed trips, so no repeat pattern is established. Neither the FULL_REFUND uplift in POL-RD-06(b) nor the conduct referral in POL-RD-06(c) is available, and the lifetime counters and other profile fields may not be substituted under POL-GEN-01. The trace is not impaired for policy purposes either: 229 fixes at a 10-second cadence, 100% coverage, no gaps, max gap 0.0 s — no POL-RD-07(a)-(c) limb fires, so the deviation stands on the trace alone and no independent corroboration is required.

THE DRIVER'S EXPLANATION. You told us a car behind flashed its high beams several times near the exit, so you believed there was an accident ahead and stayed on the expressway. POL-RD-13 tests that assertion against the trip's traffic advisory and nothing else. The only advisory in the bundle, EV-ADVIS-00504-01, is MISSING (weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT): no advisory covers the PIE eastbound between Paya Lebar and Tampines in this window. There is therefore nothing to compare the assertion against, POL-RD-03 is unavailable, and the assertion carries no weight under POL-RD-08. It is recorded as not accepted, and no part of the 14.46 km excess is excluded. Because no advisory identifier was cited as a ground, this is a gap in the bundle and not an exculpatory clause invoked against a cited artifact, so it does not escalate the case under POL-RD-10(5).

THE MONEY. The fare model is METERED, so POL-RD-02 runs: recomputed_fare = (SGD 3.80 base + 0.75 x 9.4 km = SGD 7.05 distance + 0.28 x 14.0 min = SGD 3.92 time) = SGD 14.77, times the surge multiplier of 1.0 read from the fare breakdown (EV-FARE-00504), plus the SGD 0.80 platform fee, plus zero ERP, zero fixed surcharge, zero waiting fee, less zero promo = SGD 15.57. You were charged SGD 33.17. Refund = 33.17 - 15.57 = SGD 17.60, which is 53.1% of the charge — above the SGD 0.50 de minimis and below the 90% share at which the whole fare would be returned. The fare breakdown carries no ERP, toll or airport surcharge lines (all SGD 0.00), so nothing is added on top under POL-RD-09 and nothing is double-counted. No driver compensation arises: the driver was billed 23.9 km, more than the trace's 23.86 km, so POL-RD-04's unbilled-distance limb does not apply.

OUTCOME. PARTIAL_REFUND of SGD 17.60 to the rider. No driver compensation. No referral: no clause produces one on these facts. Every surviving claim from both advocates is accepted and the parties' figures agree.

ruling.explanation:
Both parties: this was a metered (METERED) trip, TRP-00504, from Paya Lebar Square to Tampines MRT, charged at SGD 33.17. The route actually driven was a material deviation, and the fare is recomputed on the route the trip should have taken. The rider recovers SGD 17.60.

The deviation is established on the trace, as POL-RD-01 requires. EV-GPS-00504 records 23.86 km against the booked optimal of 9.4 km (EV-TRIP-00504) — an excess of 14.46 km, or 153.83% of optimal. Both establishment limbs (over 20% and over 0.8 km) are cleared, and both material figures (over 8.0 km, over 50%) are also cleared, so the driver-profile check in POL-RD-06 had to be run. As both sides correctly state, it produces nothing: EV-DPROF-00504 shows deviation_flags_90d of 0 across 250 completed trips in 90 days, so no pattern is established, there is no FULL_REFUND uplift under POL-RD-06(b) and no conduct referral under POL-RD-06(c). The lifetime prior_deviation_flags counter may not stand in for the trailing-window figure, and it was not used.

The money is arithmetic under POL-RD-02. The fare model on EV-FARE-00504 is METERED and the surge multiplier of 1.0 was read off that same fare_breakdown: recomputed_fare = (3.80 base + 0.75 x 9.4 km + 0.28 x 14.0 min) x 1.0 + 0.80 platform fee = SGD 15.57. Refund = 33.17 - 15.57 = SGD 17.60, which is above the SGD 0.50 de minimis floor and at 53.06% of the amount charged, short of the 90% share that would convert this to a full refund. So a PARTIAL_REFUND of SGD 17.60 is payable.

On the driver's explanation — the high beams from behind, the assumed accident, staying on the expressway and turning back at the next exit — the assertion is rejected as weightless, and nothing about it was believed or disbelieved on its merits; it simply cannot be tested. Under POL-RD-13 a traffic cause is checked against the trip's traffic advisory and nothing else. ruling.explanation:
To both parties: the deviation is established and the money is the ordinary arithmetical refund under the route-deviation policy.

THE DEVIATION. POL-RD-01 makes the GPS trace the governing measure, and EV-GPS-00504 records 23.86 km against the booked optimal route of 9.4 km on EV-TRIP-00504 — an excess of 14.46 km, or 153.8% of optimal. Both limbs of the establishment test clear many times over: the excess is above 20% of optimal and above 0.8 km in absolute terms. The rounded 23.9 km on the trip record was not used for the threshold test, as POL-RD-01 requires. The trace is also clean for policy purposes under POL-RD-07: 229 fixes at a 10-second cadence, 100% coverage, an empty gaps list and a maximum gap of 0.0 seconds — no gap over 90 seconds, no jump over 500 m, no sustained interval over 30 seconds. POL-RD-07 therefore imposes no independent-corroboration requirement, and the trace alone establishes the deviation. The rider's initial burden under POL-RD-08 is discharged: trip record, trace and fare breakdown all carry TRP-00504 and agree on the 18:16:40 start.

THE DRIVER'S EXCUSE. The driver's account — a car behind flashing its high beams near the exit, an assumed accident ahead, staying on the expressway and turning back at the next exit — is an asserted external traffic cause, and POL-RD-13 requires it to be tested against the trip's traffic advisory and nothing else. There is none: EV-ADVIS-00504-01 is MISSING, weight 0.0, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, and no advisory covers the PIE eastbound between Paya Lebar and Tampines in this window. The POL-RD-03 comparison cannot be run, POL-RD-03 is unavailable, and under POL-RD-08 the assertion carries no weight: not one kilometre of the 14.46 km excess is excluded. The driver named no advisory identifier, so this is a gap in the bundle rather than an exculpatory clause invoked against a cited artifact; POL-RD-10(5) does not fire, POL-RD-13(1) applies, and the case is decided rather than escalated. No other exculpatory route is open: EV-CHAT-00504 is an empty export, so there is no rider instruction of the kind POL-RD-04 needs and its corroboration test cannot even be run; pickup and dropoff were not amended, so POL-RD-05 has no stored amended optimal to work from; and the vehicle type is RYDE_X, not RYDE_POOL, so the 9.4 km solo optimal is the correct comparator under POL-RD-12.

THE DRIVER-PROFILE CHECK. Because the excess also exceeds 8.0 km and 50% of optimal, this is a MATERIAL deviation and the POL-RD-06 check had to be run. It produces nothing: driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 0 against 250 completed trips in 90 days, below both the 3-flag limb and the 0.05 ratio limb. There is therefore no FULL_REFUND uplift under POL-RD-06(b) and no driver-conduct referral under POL-RD-06(c). The lifetime prior_deviation_flags counter mentioned in argument is context only under POL-GEN-01 — it was flagged for that reason and was not used as a ground of decision in either direction.

THE MONEY. The fare model is METERED, so POL-RD-02 runs. Charged_total was SGD 33.17 (EV-FARE-00504). Recomputed on the optimal route: (SGD 3.80 base fare + 0.75 x 9.4 km = SGD 7.05 distance + 0.28 x 14.0 min = SGD 3.92 time) x the 1.0 surge multiplier read from the fare breakdown = SGD 14.77, plus SGD 0.80 platform fee, plus no ERP, no tolls, no surcharge, no waiting fee and no promo discount = SGD 15.57. Refund = SGD 33.17 - SGD 15.57 = SGD 17.60. That is above the SGD 0.50 de minimis floor, and at 53.06% of the amount charged it falls short of the 90% share that would convert the outcome into a full refund. SGD 17.60 is the correct figure and it is already a multiple of SGD 0.05.

NO ADD-ONS. Under POL-RD-09 nothing is added on top of the POL-RD-02 figure. The fare ledger carries no ERP or toll lines (off-route and on-route totals both SGD 0.00) and no airport surcharge (SGD 0.00, and the trip did not originate at an airport), so there is no standalone pass-through correction and no billing-integrity referral under POL-RD-09(4). Any off-route ERP would in any case already be comprehended in the recomputation and must never be counted twice.

NO REFERRALS. No clause on this record produces one: POL-RD-06(c) does not fire (no repeat pattern), POL-RD-09(4) does not fire (no unmatched or phantom line), and POL-NS-05(ii) and POL-NS-07 are not in issue.

CONFIDENCE. Every artifact carrying the deciding facts — the GPS trace, the trip record and the fare breakdown — is at weight 1.0, so the cap is 1.0. The missing advisory carries no fact and does not lower it. Confidence is 0.95, above the 0.70 floor, so the case is decided and not escalated.
